review_notes: Full2370B original and3961B organized source read separately, all eight complete declarations and their proof bodies checked.

The conceptual seams separate ordinary inverse equations, the stronger supplied real comparison bound, generic two-channel left reconstruction, and its historical spectral specialization. Dependent components explicitly import the exact same-version record they use.

HasTwoSidedInverse supplies both directions; these are assumptions not an existence result for H. StableInverse retains its whole inverse and arbitrary real-valued dist including possible negative distances. C>=0 is retained exactly. Calling the field lipschitz adds no metric axioms.

LiftedHeatInverse only reconstructs x from the pair heat x/residual x; it asserts neither a standalone heat inverse nor two-sided invertibility of the pair map. No ordinary inverse is inferred from the additive reconstruction identity.

The spectral specialization retains exact imported GraphHeat/tensor providers and proof term. Captured root Heat/Tensor paths differ from expected imports; root Residual actually declares Quantization.ResidualEncoding. These are explicit unresolved bindings, never aliases or activated replacements.

All eight signatures/fields/proof bodies are unchanged. Same-variant explicit imports and open directives only restore dependency/name context; no schema narrowing or legacy self-import is introduced.
